Child process started by the primary executable. Not a separate app; do not list or launch directly from a frontend's game grid.

cli.--no-launcher: skip the game-select UI, go straight into --game
cli.--setup: force the per-game setup screen before playing
cli.--integration-info: print this same launch surface as machine-readable JSON

notes: No separate builder step: DynaBrothersLauncher.exe and both *AOT.exe are shipped prebuilt in every release zip and run as-is. Deleting the extracted folder removes the whole install. Settings/cache files (settings.ini, rom-*.cfg) are written next to the executables unless GENESIS_USER_DIR is set.
